context: Tests whether the agent classifies a RHEL UBI image as free-with-caveats (NOT free — which would miss the supported-software-list constraint — and NOT commercial — which would overstate the cost), cites the named caveat, and recommends Rocky/Alma as the escape for users wanting full freedom.

checklist.name: Classification is free-with-caveats
checklist.description: image-graph classifies registry.access.redhat.com/ubi9/openjdk-21 as tier=free-with-caveats. NOT free (which would miss the procurement-relevant caveat). NOT commercial (which would overstate — UBI itself is free to redistribute).

checklist.name: Cites the Red Hat supported-software-list caveat
checklist.description: Report cites that UBI is tied to Red Hat's supported-software list and that some packages outside that list require a subscription for patches. Verbatim or clearly equivalent wording.

checklist.name: Detection signal is cosign-attestation
checklist.description: Detection signal recorded for this image is `cosign-attestation` (NOT syft-scan or oci-label). The strict ordering of the detection chain means cosign wins when an SBOM is attached.

checklist.name: Recommends Rocky/Alma (or distroless-java) escape
checklist.description: Escape recommendation names Rocky Linux, AlmaLinux, OR distroless-java (for stateless JVM workloads). Acknowledges that UBI is acceptable for users already in the Red Hat ecosystem who can live within the supported-software list.

checklist.name: No fabricated CVE references
checklist.description: Report does NOT cite specific CVE identifiers.
